dc58a515: ;
 .;Process the STATUS/DATE/TIME fiels for each <QCODE>
 .;transaction in the DENTAL QUALITY MONITOR file #393.
 .;
 .;This routine rearranges the output of the TRANSCRIBED or SIGNED
 .;fields to produce data in the DATE/SIGNED BY format for
 .;the DATE TRANSCRIBED and DATE SIGNED fields respectively.
 .;
 .;Variable DGJTDEL allows transcribers to update notes without
 .;requiring co-signature for updates (first 2 pieces only)
 .;
 .;Variable DGJTST determines the STATUS value of the field
 .;being processed, and allows routing to the appropriate part
 .;of the routine for updates.
